denied.disabled: ⛔ The `{command}` command is disabled on this server.
denied.role: 🔒 The `{command}` command is restricted to these roles: {roles}.
denied.role_gone: 🔒 The `{command}` command is restricted to roles that no longer exist. An administrator must reconfigure it with `/config module:permissions`.

panel.title: 🔐 Command permissions — {server}
panel.hint:
Choose who can use each command.
🔒 **Default**: required level (Staff, Admin…) + the command's Discord permissions.
👥 **Allowed roles**: these roles can use the command even without being staff; others cannot.
⛔ **Disabled**: nobody, except the server owner.
🔐 **Locked**: `/config` and `/help` always stay available.
The server owner always passes; Discord administrators bypass role restrictions.
panel.reset_all_confirm: All rules ({count}) will be deleted: every command goes back to its default level and is enabled again.
panel.reset_all_done: {count} rule(s) deleted: every command is back to its default behaviour.
panel.category_hint: Pick a command to set its allowed roles or disable it. The “apply to the whole category” menu gives the same roles to every editable command of the category.
panel.category_roles_placeholder: Apply these roles to the whole category…
panel.category_roles_set: {count} role(s) applied to {commands} command(s) of the category.
panel.category_roles_cleared: Roles removed from {commands} command(s) of the category.
panel.category_reset_done: Category back to default ({count} rule(s) deleted).
panel.effect_roles: These roles can use the command even without being staff; others cannot (except Discord administrators and the owner).
panel.effect_default: Default rule: level **{level}** required, plus the Discord permissions defined by the command.
panel.effect_disabled: Command disabled: nobody can use it, except the server owner.
panel.effect_locked: Locked command: it cannot be restricted, otherwise the server could lock itself out of its configuration.
panel.roles_cleared: `/{command}`: no allowed role anymore, default rule.
panel.toggled_off: `/{command}` is disabled (only the server owner can still use it).
panel.reset_done: `/{command}` is back to its default behaviour.
panel.locked_notice: `/{command}` is locked: it cannot be changed.
panel.discord_hidden: ⚠️ Discord hides this command from members without some permissions (command setting): to make it visible to these roles, also adjust Server Settings → Integrations → the bot.
